frequency_comparison.observation: Plateau scales almost exactly with configured frequency although active sample timestamps remain about102ms apart. Nominal-frequency normalization is implicated; this is not a source-level proof of the driver formula.

interpretation.mem_load: 10Hz removes the50x numerical inflation relative to500Hz, but the counter is not validated as HBM-only bandwidth and its scale/integration semantics remain unverified.
interpretation.llc: Per-row unit is empty. Values decrease as well as increase and therefore are not a monotonically cumulative counter. Counts around1.3497e9/8.0983e8/6.7486e8 align with preceding170/102/85ms intervals; this suggests interval counts ending at timestamp, not values integrated over the forward display dur. Request size, exact coverage and normalization are not verified; do not convert to bytes or bandwidth.
interpretation.synchronization: All18 fully-contained values are0%. The only nonzero overlapping row starts before the NVTX window. This does not establish absence of synchronization cost: supported counter coverage/denominator is not verified, and barrier instruction cost need not equal issue-stall synchronization waiting.

limits: All data are from synthetic standalone frozen-baseline producer replay, not service acceptance.
The three selectors ran in separate processes, not simultaneously.
Every database has one terminal dur=-1 row outside the measured window; excluded.
No per-kernel timeline rows are emitted inside graph replay.
Duration-weighted values describe the database forward-held display only; do not mistake that dur for hardware integration duration.
No bandwidth-saturation, occupancy, elapsed-time stall percentage, or memory-bound conclusion follows from these records alone.
